title: Stretch
description: “to run away” in a tall condensed serif over herb’s Times Square night, graded down to streetlight. Grab any letter and drag: the row under your finger repeats like a pixel-stretched lyric edit, then eases home unless you flick it to stay.
intent: One mechanic from the reference: a glyph slit-scanned from the grab row, the y's tail pulled down the frame, as a thing you do with your hand.
